title: SCI Receive
text: Receive data on target via serial communication interface (SCI) from host, 1 input, 2 outputs, {Additional package terminator} sets Indicates end of data; {SCI module}, {Additional package header} Indicates start of data, {Number of retries for header receive check} sets the custom retrial count for header receive, {Data type}, {Data length option} sets the data length the block receives Length via, {Data length} sets the number of data types the block receives, {Max data length} sets the maximum number of data types the block, {Initial output} sets the default value output from block, {Action taken when connection times out} selects type of output when connection times out Output the last received, {Output value when connection times out} sets the custom output value from block when connection times, {Sample time} sets the frequency at which data is read from SCI, {Wait until data received} sets the wait until requested data is available, {Timeout} sets the amount of time in seconds the block waits until data is received and {Output receiving status} sets the status of serial communication. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Length
ports.summary: Data length received from input port scalar

ports.name: Data
ports.summary: Data received from serial bus scalar | vector

params.name: SCI module
params.values: SCI module for communication A (default) | B | C | D

params.name: Additional package header
params.values: Indicates start of data ’S’ (default) | string | char | number from 0 to 255

params.name: Additional package terminator
params.values: Indicates end of data ’E’ (default) | string | char | number from 0 to 255

params.name: Number of retries for header receive check
params.values: Custom retrial count for header receive check 16 (default) | positive integer, finite | scalar

params.name: Data type
params.values: Data type of output data uint8 (default) | single | int8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32

params.name: Data length option
params.values: Data length the block receives Length via dialog (default) | Length via input port | Variable length

params.name: Data length
params.values: Number of data types the block receives 1 (default) | positive integer, finite | scalar

params.name: Max data length
params.values: Maximum number of data types the block receives 1 (default) | positive integer, finite | positive integer, finite

params.name: Initial output
params.values: Default value output from block 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Action taken when connection times out
params.values: Select type of output when connection times out Output the last received value (default) | Output custom value

params.name: Output value when connection times out
params.values: Custom output value from block when connection times out 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Frequency at which data is read from SCI device 0.1 (default) | -1 | scalar

params.name: Wait until data received
params.values: Wait until requested data is available off (default) | on

params.name: Timeout
params.values: Amount of time in seconds the block waits until data is received inf (default) | positive value greater than 0

params.name: Output receiving status
params.values: Status of serial communication off (default) | on
